quotaMonitorConsent: Allow this app to keep reading the trusted collector for this exact provider account after you leave this page, including after app restart. A cycle checks at most three saved sources, every five minutes in the foreground or fifteen minutes while your existing background service is active. With more than three sources, each source may wait several cycles. Device alerts require the separate switch below and a freshly reported window at or above the selected percentage used. An alert records that past reading; open it to check current usage. Personal page thresholds are separate. No service is started here.
quotaMonitorRuntime: Sources are checked in rotation, at most three per cycle; larger lists take several cycles. Background reads require the existing live service to be active; Android may stop it. Displayed readings expire when the collector says they do. Device alerts record past threshold readings, not current remaining allowance. This page never switches your active server.

tailscaleQuickAdd: Use your private network and an HTTPS server address
tailscaleIntro: Reach OpenCode on another computer through your own Tailscale network. You control sign-in and VPN access in the official Tailscale app.
tailscaleInstalled: Tailscale is installed. VPN connection is unverified.
tailscaleMissing: Tailscale is not installed. Install the official app, then return and check again.
tailscaleUnknown: Could not check the app. Try again, or open Tailscale from your phone.
tailscaleUnsupported: This device cannot open the Android app. Set up Tailscale on this device yourself, then review your HTTPS address below.
tailscaleVpnHandoff: In Tailscale, sign in to the network that can reach your server, approve Android’s VPN prompt if asked, and turn the connection on. OpenCode cannot see or change that VPN state.
tailscaleReturned: Welcome back. App presence was checked again; use Test connection on the next screen to check your server.
tailscaleOpenFailed: Tailscale could not open. Open it from your launcher, then return here. Your address stays in this form.
tailscaleAddressDetail: Use the full HTTPS origin printed by Tailscale Serve, such as https://computer.tailnet-name.ts.net. Keep any HTTPS port it prints. A short device name or a raw HTTP port may not provide a valid certificate.
tailscaleAddressError: Enter an HTTPS origin with a valid port (1–65535). Remove paths, credentials, query text and fragments. Use the full address from Serve; do not replace https with http.
tailscaleReviewDetail: Continue only with an address you recognize. The next screen reviews your server credentials before you explicitly test or save. This app cannot confirm that an address is private from its name alone.
tailscaleServeHelp: On the server computer, Tailscale Serve can provide private HTTPS for a local OpenCode port. Use Serve, not public Funnel. Your tailnet access rules still apply. Enabling HTTPS publishes the certificate’s device and tailnet names in a public certificate log, although access stays private. Review the official guide before changing your server.
tailscaleRecovery: If the server is unreachable, check Tailscale on both devices, the full HTTPS name and port, Serve on the server, and your network’s access rules. A VPN or DNS conflict may also prevent access. Keep HTTPS enabled. Correct the server password if authentication is rejected, then retry Test connection.
tailscaleEditorDetail: Your network connection is managed in Tailscale. Test connection checks this OpenCode server, not the VPN. Enter the server’s own username and password here, not your Tailscale login. Setup help keeps these fields intact.
a2aDraftSaveError: Draft changes could not be saved. Keep this screen open and retry before leaving.
a2aBoundary: Connect to an A2A agent and send a task you choose. Only the text you submit is shared. Your projects, files and other conversations stay on this phone.
a2aEmpty: No external agents yet. Start with an agent's HTTPS address or public Agent Card URL.
a2aDeleteAgentDetail: Remove this agent, its saved tasks and its credential from this phone. This does not stop remote work or delete data held by the agent.
a2aDeletionPending: Local deletion is incomplete. This agent is unavailable until its remaining data is removed.
a2aUnsupported: Unavailable: this card does not advertise the supported A2A 1.0 JSON-RPC, text and authentication combination on the same origin, or requires an unsupported extension. No task can be sent.
a2aBearerDetail: Supply an HTTP bearer credential issued for this agent. It is stored in the phone's secure storage and sent only to the inspected origin. No sign-in or credential sharing with other agents is performed.
a2aNoAuthDetail: This card requests no authentication. Do not send private information unless you trust this agent.
a2aCardClaim: Self-reported Agent Card. This app has not verified the agent's identity, skills or billing terms.
a2aSendDetail: Review the text and destination before sending. The agent may use its own compute or services; check its terms. This app cannot estimate or limit that usage.
a2aReopenDetail: Reopening checks the existing task. It never sends your task again.
a2aFresh: Checked with the agent this visit.
a2aSavedSnapshot: Saved locally. Refresh a known task to check its current state.
a2aCancelDetail: Ask this agent to cancel this task. Work may already have finished, and the agent decides whether cancellation is possible.
a2aForgetDetail: Remove this saved task from the phone. Remote work may continue, including a send whose delivery is unconfirmed. This cannot delete the agent's copy.
a2aOmittedContent: Some output is omitted. This view shows bounded text and links; binary or structured artifacts are not downloaded or executed.
a2aAddressError: Use an HTTPS origin or public Agent Card URL without credentials, query or fragment. HTTP is supported only on this device's loopback address.
a2aAuthenticationError: The agent rejected or could not use this credential. Return to the agent to update it, then reopen the saved task.
a2aUnavailable: The agent could not be reached or rejected this operation. Refresh a known task to check its state.
a2aInvalidResponse: The agent returned an unsupported, oversized or mismatched response. The saved task has not been replaced.
a2aUncertain: The agent may have received this message. It will not be resent. If a task ID was confirmed, refresh to check progress; otherwise check with the agent before starting another task.
a2aStorageError: Local data could not be saved or removed. Check device storage and retry the local operation. A message without a saved delivery marker is not sent.
a2aScopeError: This agent, credential or saved task changed. Close this view and reopen the agent to continue.
a2aCancelUnconfirmed: Cancellation is not confirmed. The agent still reports an active task; refresh to check again.
a2aAuthRequiredDetail: This agent requested an additional authentication flow, which this client does not support. No automatic login or task continuation will occur.
a2aUnknownDetail: This task state is not supported. You can refresh or forget the local record; sending and cancellation remain unavailable.
fileSourceExcerpt: Up to the first 200,000 characters are displayed. Copy and Save keep the original content.
filePreviewPartialSource: Only part of this file is shown. Copy and Save keep the original content.
fileLineOutsidePreview: Line {line} is outside this preview. Save the original to read that location.
fileTableMalformed: This file has incomplete or inconsistent quoting. Read its source instead.
fileTableTooLarge: Table preview supports files up to 256 KB. Read the source or save the original file.
fileTableTooWide: This file has more than 32 columns. Read the source or save the original file.
fileTableFieldTooLong: A cell exceeds 4,096 characters. Read the source or save the original file.
fileTableMoreRows: Showing the first 200 rows. More data remains in the original file.
fileCopyFailed: Could not copy file contents. Try again.
fileSvgUnsupported: This SVG cannot be shown as a local static image. Read its source or save the original file. External resources, animation and complex SVG features are not supported.
filePdfEncrypted: This PDF requires a password or uses unsupported protection. Save the original to open it in a PDF app.
filePdfLimit: PDF preview supports files up to 10 MB and the first 200 pages. Save the original to read the full document.
filePdfUnavailable: PDF viewing is available on Android 10 or newer. You can still save the original file.
filePdfCancelled: PDF loading cancelled. Retry when you are ready.
filePdfFailed: This PDF page could not be displayed. Retry or save the original file.
filePdfPageLimit: Only the first 200 pages can be previewed. Save the original to read the full document.
agentAccountScopeLost: This connection changed. Return to Servers and open the account for the connected profile.
agentAccountHostNote: The official Codex runtime keeps your provider credentials. Account changes apply to this host, including other profiles connected to it.
agentAccountUnsupportedDetail: This panel is verified with Codex 0.153.4. The connected runtime may not support these account methods.
agentAccountReconnectDetail: Account data and the sign-in code were cleared. Reconnect to refresh. Sign-in will not restart automatically.
agentAccountSignInNote: Start an official device-code sign-in on this host. Complete it in your browser; the app never receives your provider tokens.
agentAccountLimitsUnavailable: Rate limits are unavailable for this account or host.
agentAccountUsageUnavailable: Token usage is unavailable for this account or host.
agentAccountUsageNote: Values are reported by the host. Missing values are unknown, not zero. Token counts are not a bill or remaining message allowance.
agentAccountLoginFailed: Sign-in did not complete. Check the host and try again.
agentAccountLoginUncertain: The host could not confirm sign-in or cancellation. It may still be waiting. Check the official host runtime before starting again.
agentAccountCodeHint: Enter this one-time code on the official sign-in page. Keep it private.
projectFolderChooserMessage: OpenCode Mobile does not work in the server’s home folder. Create a new folder or open a project folder to start sessions.
projectFolderNoCreateHint: This server cannot create folders from the app. Create the folder on that machine, then open it here by its path.
projectFolderCreateMessage: The folder is created in {directory} on this device and opened as the workspace.
projectFolderOpenMessage: Enter the full path of a folder on the server. The home folder itself cannot be used; choose a project inside it.
projectFolderOpenSubtitle: Enter the full path of a folder on the server
globalSessionsSearchHint: Across every folder on this server
globalSessionsEmptyMessage: Sessions from every folder on this server will appear here.
globalSessionsNoMatchMessage: Try a shorter title search or include archived sessions.
workspaceManageProjectHint: Switch project, worktrees, and project health
reviewMissingContext: {count} unchanged lines not included in patch

@settingsDiscoveryNewChatsModel.description: More destination summary showing the model used by new chats, not an existing session.

onboardingValueBody: Ask your coding agent for a change, review the result, and pick up where you left off.
onboardingDemoNote: A simulated session. No server needed.
onboardingPrivateNetwork: Reach a server over your private network
activityCheckedLocationsClear: Nothing needs you in the checked locations.
activityUnknownStatusDetail: No requests loaded. Some server activity is still unknown.
activityBackgroundOffDetail: Off · choose when to stay connected
demoTaskInstruction: Send the sample prompt below, then review the proposed edit.
modelChoiceProvidersSummary: {count, plural, =1{1 signed-in provider not loaded. View details} other{{count} signed-in providers not loaded. View details}}
modelChoicePartialSaveError: Model saved. Agent choice was not confirmed. Try again.
modelChoiceModelSaveError: Could not confirm the model choice. Check your selection and try again.
workBackgroundRequested: Background work requested. Status will update when the server reports it.
workBackgroundUnavailable: This server has not confirmed support for moving work to the background.
workBackgroundEligible: Run in background is available while a supported agent task or command is blocking this chat.
workBackgroundAutomatic: Ask your agent to delegate work in the background. Results return to this chat automatically.

@oc2DiscoveryConnect.description: Opens the existing-server editor for someone looking for OpenCode 2; does not force the protocol.

oc2DiscoveryExisting: Use a server that is already running.
oc2DiscoveryPhone: Set up OpenCode 1 or 2 on this phone.
setupSwitchConfirmDetail: Stops this phone’s server and running tasks. Chats, provider settings and credentials stay separate; project files and configuration are shared. You can switch back.
setupSwitchPending: The runtime switch has not finished. Retry the selected runtime or return to the previous one. Your saved runtime data is retained.
setupSwitchInProgressHint: You can leave this screen and return to check progress.
setupSwitchFailed: Could not finish switching runtimes. Check the setup output, then retry or return to the previous runtime.
setupSwitchLegacyTwo: This OpenCode 2 installation keeps its existing data. Switching it to OpenCode 1 is not available.
setupSwitchReady: The local runtime is ready. Your current remote connection is unchanged.
setupSwitchMissingCredential: The saved credential for the previous runtime is unavailable. Its data is retained; restore the saved profile before returning.
setupSwitchOwnDescription: Connect an existing OpenCode 1 or OpenCode 2 server by address.
setupSwitchDataNotice: Each version keeps its own chats and provider settings. Project files and project configuration are shared.
